subject: Private hosting: schedule ops + architecture review for MedAlign
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@medalign.com>; Tom Li <tom.li@medalign.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Private hosting: schedule ops + architecture review for MedAlign

Hi Alicia / Tom —

Thanks again for the discovery call today. Helpful to understand the compliance and isolation needs you outlined (SOC2 scope, VPC peering constraints, and the on-prem adjacency requirement for the inference inference runners). Per our conversation, the next step we recommend is a 60–75 minute architecture & ops review where our infra leads walk through:

- high-level private deployment options (VPC vs air-gapped on-prem)
- network topologies we typically implement (VPN, private link, transit)
- data flow and encryption at rest/in flight, KMS integration points
- ops playbook: upgrades, monitoring, incident runbooks and audit logs

Proposed time windows (all PT):
- Tue Sep 16, 09:00–10:15 or 13:00–14:15
- Wed Sep 17, 11:00–12:15 or 15:00–16:15

If those don't work, send a couple slots that do and we'll adapt. I've attached our discovery notes and a short prep checklist for the call so your infra and security folks can skim ahead.

Prep attachments: MedAlign-discovery-notes.pdf, Redwood-arch-prep-checklist.pdf

Goal: by the end of the call we want to have an agreed scope for a proof-of-concept (PoC) plan and a primary technical contact at your side for test environments.

Thanks — looking forward.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@medalign.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@medalign.com>, procurement@medalign.com
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private hosting: schedule ops + architecture review for MedAlign

Karthik —

Thanks for the recap and the notes (received). Quick answers and availability from our side:

- SOC2 in-scope for data-at-rest in the model store; we need KMS integration and a shortlist of supported HSM/KMS vendors.
- Tom (cc'd) will be primary technical contact for the call. He leads infra at MedAlign.
- Procurement looped for any follow-up on contractual terms.

Best matching slots: Tue Sep 16, 13:00–14:15 PT or Wed Sep 17, 11:00–12:15 PT. The latter might be slightly better for Tom.

We also wanted to see a short run-through of how Redwood handles offline model patching for air-gapped sites — so please include that in the agenda.

I'll push the invite once we confirm.

Thanks,
Alicia
Alicia Ramos
Head of Product Integration, MedAlign
alicia.ramos@medalign.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private hosting: schedule ops + architecture review for MedAlign

Karthik / Markus —

Thanks — Alicia picked two candidate slots and flagged the air-gapped patching flow. Markus, can you confirm whether you and I should present the ops runbook + patching flow together, or would you prefer I cover the customer-facing checklist and you deep-dive the network/topology?

Also: procurement included a separate doc request in their first reply — I attached a short PoC commercial outline (proposed-mvp-ops-runbook.docx) we can share during the meeting. If legal wants a redline, we should capture that after the technical alignment.

I can present Tue 13:00 PT if that gets the calendar locked; if Tom prefers Wed 11:00 PT that's fine — we should confirm today so Alicia can send the invite.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

All —

Wed Sep 17, 11:00–12:15 PT works best for me. Please go ahead and lock that. For the agenda, please include:

1) Network/topology options and VPN/peering tradeoffs (15–20m)
2) KMS/HSM integration and key rotation (15m)
3) Air-gap/offline model patching process (15m)
4) PoC scope & next steps (15–20m)

Alicia — can you send the calendar invite. Karthik / Marissa / Markus — please bring any short runbooks or diagrams you referenced in the prep checklist.

Thanks,
Tom

Director of Infrastructure, MedAlign
tom.li@medalign.com
